backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining products, orders, user profiles, and service quote management with admin-restricted retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing a footer update feature, listing affected frontend file and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of multiple frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring TanStack Router routes including storefront, cart, checkout, admin, and quote pages.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with brand blurb mentioning Manitoba and Ontario, contact phone, quick links, and social icons.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with logo, navigation links, and cart button showing item count.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering Header, Outlet, and Footer.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Reusable card displaying a product’s image, details, price, and link to its detail page.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders a FAQ section using an accordion with predefined questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials in cards with star ratings and text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows trust badges with icons and brief labels describing service assurances.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks to fetch and update service quotes via the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all orders and update order statuses.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Provides hooks for CRUD operations on products including creating, updating, archiving, and restoring.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the caller’s user role from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state and exposes login, logout, and identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Provides a mutation to place an order and invalidate order queries afterward.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Fetches active products or a specific product using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Provides a mutation to submit service quote requests with success and error toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout handling authentication, role checks, and navigation for admin sections.
Admin interface for viewing, sorting, and updating service quote leads including statuses and notes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Displays all orders with status editing and loading states for admin management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Product management UI for creating, editing, and archiving products with dialog forms.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Displays the shopping cart, allowing quantity updates, item removal, and navigation when empty.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Handles checkout form validation and order submission, then redirects to confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Shows a confirmation message and optional order ID after a successful purchase.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Fetches and displays product details with quantity selection and add‑to‑cart functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Provides a service quote request form with validation and submission, showing a success screen afterward.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Renders the storefront hero, trust signals, and product listings with navigation to shopping and quote request.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with persistence, quantity updates, and total calculation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, extended color tokens using CSS variables, custom animations, fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state, including requirements, architectural notes, known issues, and features for building a spray-foam product storefront app.
